text: Si jinnaaɓe maa ɓen etike fawugol sirkangol Alla, wata a ɗofto ɓe e ɗum; tawde ɗoftagol alanaa tagaaɗo, e yeddugol taguɗo On. Wonndir e maɓɓe ka aduna ɗoo, ɗiggere, e jokkagol ɓe moƴƴoo e maɓɓe. Jokku laawol on ruttiiɗo faade e tawhiidi e ɗoftaare. Refti ko ka An tun, woni ruttorde mon on fow, Ñalnde Darngal. Mi humpitoya on ko gollaynoɗon kon aduna, Mi yoɓita on ɗum.
